policy.nodeStages: Dockerfile development/build/runtime all use node:26-alpine (major branch; host/CI exact pin stays in .nvmrc).
policy.mutableTags: Compose and Dockerfile keep mutable tags so Dependabot docker updates remain reviewable security PRs.
policy.digestLock: Exact digests and platform are recorded here when preparing a release candidate; mutable tags are never production deploy inputs.
updateProcess: Dependabot opens a docker ecosystem PR that changes the mutable tag or digest reference in Dockerfile/compose*.yaml.
On an approved candidate SHA, resolve linux/amd64 (or the selected release platform) digests with docker buildx imagetools inspect <ref>.
Update deploy/infra-image-pins.json images[].digest/platform and set status to resolved; the diff is the reviewable pin change.
Copy the same digests into the release manifest (OPS-08). Do not treat CI cache tags or :latest as deploy inputs.
PostgreSQL major stays 18 with volume /var/lib/postgresql; engine major upgrades are a separate operator procedure from app schema migrations.

images.note: Dockerfile development/build/runtime stages follow node:26-alpine; host/CI exact pin remains in .nvmrc.
Preserve major 18 and /var/lib/postgresql mount; major engine upgrade is out of band.

observedAtPrep.note: Resolved via docker buildx imagetools; still not a production deploy authorization.
